title: Fri 30 Oct: Anthropic's IPO and AI economics
summary: Anthropic's IPO filing leads, with Mistral's model release, AI costs at banks and agentic payments.

title: Wed 28 Oct: Banks lend $63B for Anthropic chips
summary: Broadcom has reportedly closed a $63B vehicle to finance Anthropic's chips, with Citi among the lenders, and Anthropic's S-1 shows the scale of its compute bills. Also in the brief: Meta's raise nears $100B, and Cloudflare and LiteLLM leaks show AI infrastructure risk.

title: Mon 26 Oct: Wall Street asks where AI pays
summary: Apollo's chief economist says AI has delivered zero payoff outside Big Tech, as Meta's credit spread hits a record. Also: Washington turns on AI's chief executives, and China's AI compute is set to double in 2027.

title: Sun 25 Oct: Neocloud credit tests Nvidia's backstop
summary: Neocloud credit stress puts Nvidia's 171.5 billion dollars of backing to the test. Plus Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro near the frontier, and OpenAI winning Replit with a deep discount.

title: Sat 24 Oct: Citi draws a line on AI agents
summary: Citi's know-your-agent line, OpenAI raising at 1.25 trillion dollars, token prices halving while GPU rents climb, and your read-later list.
